'''Ekuda''' was a celestial body in the [[Ekuda system/Legends|Ekuda system]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Alpha Squadron|Alpha]] and [[Tau Squadron]]s [[Battle of Ekuda|attacked]] the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Calamari Cruiser]] ''[[Tano]]'' in space near Ekuda.<ref name="XWvTF" />
